text:
sara: onboarding complete for aurora-lite-7b (q4f16). Canary started 04:00 PST (10% traffic). Two signals: repeated token loops on short prompts, and 95th pct latency +60% vs baseline. Opening thread for triage. Samples below.
ajay: can you paste one or two minimal repro prompts + outputs? also which backend config did you use (fused_attn, kv cache settings)?
sara: repro prompt: 'Is Paris in France?' -> model outputs:

Yes.
Yes.
Yes.

Another: 'Confirm: chess is a board game?' -> repeated confirmations. Config: q4f16 + fused_attention=true, kv_cache=true, batch_size=1. Canary route: redwood/canary/aurora-lite-7b:q4f16
maria: ran shortprompts eval (1k samples). top-line: repeat_rate q4f16=3.7% vs fp16 baseline=0.6%. 95th_latency q4f16=230ms vs baseline=140ms. BLEU/QA roughly same. Repetition metric is the outlier.
kevin: infra note: 95th latency jump lines up with GPU mem evictions on node g12-14 around 04:15. Logs show kv_cache_rewind thrash and occasional OOM-retry. Prom query I used:
```
sum(rate(gpu_memory_evictions_total[5m])) by (instance)
```
spike on g12-14.
ops-bot: ALERT: canary-slo-deviation aurora-lite-7b q4f16 95th_latency > 50% threshold triggered at 04:18. Incident id: INC-248000-12
jamal: hypotheses: (1) quantization changed logits distribution causing token-repeat loops, (2) fused_attention + kv_cache interaction causing decoder replay. Quick mitigation: reduce canary to 0% or switch canary to fp16. Can someone try rollback to fp16 or disable fused_attention on canary?
sara: I'm going to pin canary to fp16 variant for 30m and rerun the shortprompt eval. Will post results and attach decoder logits/topk for a few repro cases.
ajay: if rollback confirmed, I'll add a shortprompt regression test to the canary gate: block q4f16 rollout unless repeat_rate <= 1%. I'll own it.
maria: I'll add sample-level metric to eval dashboard to count repeated-token runs >3 and surface diffs by quantization profile.
kevin: quick local smoke: disabling fused_attention on q4f16 reduced repetition significantly. Could be a kernel optimization bug in fused path. If repro holds, we should file with @eng-runtime.
sara: action items: 1) rollback canary -> fp16 (sara) 2) create shortprompt regression test (ajay) 3) add repeat-rate metric to eval dashboard (maria) 4) file runtime bug against fused_attention (kevin). Tagging @eng-runtime. :white_check_mark:
